comparison.objective: Mount the correct grinding wheel and flange/blotter stack on a bench grinder, tighten safely, then pass spin and axial-tug checks.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered coaxial assembly, keyed-flange alignment, nut tightening within a damage limit, and safe hands-clear testing.
comparison.success_condition: Correct complete stack, seated nut below the over-torque limit, less than 5° slip during braked spin, under 0.3 mm axial motion under an 18 N tug, and hands clear; damaged-wheel use or cracking forces zero.
comparison.reason: The candidate preserves an adjustable angular stop while counterholding a concentric screw and jam nut, then verifies repeated retained articulation; this record instead assembles a wheel stack and validates frictional clamping.
